description: This source file contains functions for processing messages, applying customizable rules, and optionally integrating with Jira to ensure issues are synced. It includes logic for rule application, message updating, and handling Jira synchronization status.

methods.name: List[Rule] _load_active_rules(db: Session)
methods.description: Loads active rules from the database, ordered by creation date for deterministic application.

methods.name: Message apply_rules(db: Session, message: Message)
methods.description: Applies active rules to modify the message content based on rule definitions such as prefixing.

methods.name: bool process_message(db: Session, message: Message)
methods.description: Processes a message by applying rules, synchronizing with Jira if linked, and updating message status accordingly.

ctags.name: process_message
ctags.pattern: /^async def process_message(db: Session, message: Message) -> bool:$/
